appraisal_events.evidence: Oubliant sans doute que lui-même ne touchait pas cinq cents francs d'appointements mensuels, il méprisait profondément les personnes pour qui cinq cents francs... est « une somme »... race de parias à qui n'était pas destiné le Grand-Hôtel; Il émaillait ses propos commerciaux d'expressions choisies, mais à contresens.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator paints the hotel director as a hypocritical snob who judges guests solely by superficial signs of wealth despite his own modest income, and whose pretensions to elegant speech are undercut by his malapropisms.

appraisal_events.evidence: Alors ma grand’mère entra; et à l'expansion de mon cœur refoulé s'ouvrirent aussitôt des espaces infinis. ... sa blouse de servante et de garde, son habit de religieuse ... étayé sur un désir de conservation et d'accroissement de ma propre vie autrement fort que celui que j'avais de moi-même.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator elevates the grandmother by portraying her arrival as dissolving his anguish instantly and by describing her care as a boundless, self-effacing devotion that exceeds ordinary affection, culminating in an intimate physical closeness.

status_effects.explanation: The director is locally diminished by the narrator's satirical portrait of his snobbery, his misjudgment of guests by superficial wealth signals, and his self-undermining pretensions to refined language.
The grandmother is elevated through the narrator's admiring depiction of her selfless, all-encompassing devotion and care.
The narrator's anguish and isolation give way to relief and intimate comfort upon the grandmother's arrival, culminating in the closing image of physical closeness.
